## Verification

- [ ] `npm ci` succeeds on a clean checkout.
- [ ] `npm test -- --runInBand` passes.
- [ ] Relevant isolated integration script(s) pass.
- [ ] The application starts with temporary/test data.
- [ ] No database, backup, credentials, generated installer, or customer data is included.
- [ ] Existing inventory, Khata, accounting, and upgrade behavior remains compatible.
